title: The reviewed skill tree guard treats the owned vendor tree list and its test fixtures as inventory, and still fails on a real read of a skill tree
steps: S1: From the repository checkout run: node --test scripts/test/related-tests.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the two reviewed skill tree guard cases.
expect: 'only declared readers read a reviewed skill tree; inventory lines may name one' passes although scripts/test/owned-vendor-trees.test.ts names the WordPress theme skill and EmDash skill trees as path fixtures.
'no test reaches a reviewed skill tree through a module that reads it' passes although that test imports scripts/lib/owned-vendor-trees.ts, whose path rows name those trees.
Before the fix (develop at 3807bf609) both cases failed with 'reads vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/' and 'loads scripts/lib/owned-vendor-trees.ts'.
evidence: CI on every pull request after the move to the public repository: the two guard cases in the tests rows were red.
fence: The INVENTORY_LINE patterns match only line shapes (path rows, scope fixture rows, the Markdown fixture call) and never spell a tree path; a line in either file that reads a file inside a skill tree still fails the guard (checked by hand, not by this case).

tests: only declared readers read a reviewed skill tree; inventory lines may name one
no test reaches a reviewed skill tree through a module that reads it
